alternativeSelection.assessment: Three plans share entrepreneurship, economics, research and digital strategy. The broad plan balances environmental and biomedical applications. The energy plan adds renewable technology, system design and material recovery. The life sciences plan adds cell biology, physiology, practical laboratory work and health behavior. The specialised plans address the two official domains within UCR’s course coverage. Dedicated transport engineering, applied thermodynamics and specialist innovation projects remain material differences.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both introduce how ventures develop and implement ideas. Utrecht focuses specifically on innovation theory.
Both study organizational strategy and technology adoption. UCR focuses on digital transformation.
Both develop quantitative analysis. UCR applies regression methods to economic questions.
Both examine organizations, teams and change. UCR emphasizes organizational psychology.
Utrecht requires a project that applies innovation methods. UCR develops related inquiry skills across courses.
Both examine economic decisions and markets. Utrecht applies these ideas to technological change.
Both use mathematics to model change, including differential equations.
Both develop research design, measurement and evidence analysis.
Utrecht studies long-term change across natural and human history in one course.
Utrecht requires a dedicated course in thermodynamics and energy conversion.
Utrecht studies innovation systems across firms, sectors and institutions. UCR addresses related governance and strategy in separate courses.
Both study energy technologies. UCR emphasizes renewable generation, storage and grid integration.
Utrecht requires an innovation project for an external client. UCR’s energy plan includes a renewable-design project for a partner.
Both consider how to deploy energy technology. UCR focuses on renewable system design, while Utrecht includes transport innovation.
Both examine energy and material use. UCR emphasizes product life cycles and reuse.
Utrecht teaches dedicated methods for assessing technologies. UCR develops related evaluation and ethical reasoning across courses.
Utrecht requires a 15 EC thesis in the chosen domain. UCR offers optional independent research outside the scheduled degree.
Choose 45 EC of electives, including at least 7.5 EC at advanced level in this example.

notes.text: Utrecht combines innovation studies with one science domain. The UCR options combine business, research and science, with a broad plan and two plans that emphasize energy or health.

The Utrecht example uses Energy & Transport. It includes dedicated thermodynamics, transport innovation, two innovation projects and a required thesis. Utrecht also offers a Life Sciences domain. UCR’s health plan draws on related biomedical science and laboratory work.

audience.programmeDescription: Utrecht’s mainly Dutch-taught bachelor combines natural science with the study of how technologies develop and how organizations and society adopt them.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The Utrecht example follows Energy & Transport and Innovation in Firms and Markets. Utrecht also offers Life Sciences and two other innovation learning lines. The three UCR options cover broad science and innovation, renewable energy, or health.
